description: This file defines types and functions related to handling strategic patching in Kubernetes, including schema visitors for patch items, and parsing patch metadata extensions.

classes.name: kindItem
classes.description: Implements LookupPatchItem for handling schema items expected to be of kind type, with methods for visiting schema components and error handling.

classes.name: sliceItem
classes.description: Implements LookupPatchItem for handling schema items expected to be slices, with methods for visiting schema components and error handling.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error encountered during schema visiting.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the schema path associated with the item.

methods.name: VisitPrimitive
methods.description: Handles visiting a primitive schema node, sets error if type does not match expectations.

methods.name: VisitArray
methods.description: Handles visiting an array schema node, sets error if type does not match expectations.

methods.name: VisitMap
methods.description: Handles visiting a map schema node, sets error if type does not match expectations.

methods.name: VisitReference
methods.description: Handles visiting a reference schema node, proceeds if not visited yet.

methods.name: VisitKind
methods.description: Handles visiting a kind schema node, extracts patch metadata.
